title: Airy Sweet Italian Milk Chocolate Cassata
description: A fermented, shattering, Italian dessert featuring milk chocolate and score-fat, perfect for a brunch mood, this plant-based-friendly cassata is a unique treat. It combines the richness of milk chocolate with the airiness of fermented ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add the score-fat, non-dairy milk, and vanilla extract to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large rectangle.
Spread the milk chocolate evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Roll the dough into a tight log and place it in a greased cassata pan.
Bake the cassata for 35 minutes or until it is golden brown.
Let the cassata cool completely before dusting it with confectioners sugar and serving.
